record.label: Literal reverse-Hermite / backward-functional route
record.summary: Closed at the exact tested scope. RESULT.json (SHA-256 785d789a9ce588989f6ab070d84c6dfdf8ec4faaacc3eabf1bbe791fb49b70e6) proves the compressed reverse transport and forward Duhamel sum for fixed sources agree to 1.9244557334329387e-16, so reversing direction adds no new operator at the same finite truncation. The target-free K5/K7/K9/K12 source ladder fails the frozen accuracy, alignment, degree, stability, finite-width, and novelty gates: K12 geometric-mean baseline/corrected MSE improvement is 0.000131045125647072 (required >=3 on every network), and even K5's best single-network improvement is only 1.4682954929865684. The literal non-equivalent degree-5 scalar basis needs at least 9,474,438,804,480 homogeneous coefficients, already 4.31x the complete 2^41 FLOP budget before transport or evaluation. This closes the cheap finite reverse-Hermite spelling and literal full-basis alternative only; B1B preserves a future named structured or factorized representation.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed by exact reverse/forward Duhamel identity, the failed frozen K5-K12 small-n ladder, and the literal full degree-5 scalar-basis rank/cost lower bound. The closure does not cover a future representation with separately proved structure and compression.
